paper.title: Beyond First-order Asymptotics in Sequential Mean Testing

claims.scope: Fixed-sample KL_inf CLT at the declared finite settings with independent replay and negative control.
Stopping-time CLT at the declared finite boundary and path count.
Exact decomposition, optimizer remainder, full-prefix windows, and Anscombe finite audit.
Literal interval target is falsified; the displayed deterministic-target formula is supported for the tested Bernoulli law.
Synthetic and pinned public DSSAT-pool checks; exact author crop-yield data is unavailable.

limitations: Finite evidence does not replace the paper's universal asymptotic proofs.
Claim 5 uses a disclosed public-data substitution rather than the exact author pool.
No new live evaluator score is claimed; the previous 3/10 score and projected scores remain historical/forecast records.
